info.title: Line Management Global Offering Service
info.description: This is the API for the Line Management Global Offering entity and should be the way to get or search Global Offering data.

get.description: How you get a single global offering.

parameters.name: objectId
parameters.description: A single Id of the object (in this case Line Management Product Offering ID)

parameters.name: _dataunits
parameters.description: The data units that would be desired, default returns just core data

parameters.name: X-B3-TraceId
parameters.description: A UUID that will uniquely identify a reqest for tracking purposes, if not passed one will be assigned

parameters.name: x-api-key
parameters.description: The api key that will identify an application with the AWS API Gateway and is used for tracking and throttling

200.description: Returns response object which contains global offering core with requested data units

X-B3-TraceId.description: A UUID that will uniquely identify a reqest for tracking purposes

cache-control.description: Will indicate rules around caching of the content returned.

expires.description: Will indicate a time when this data should be expired in the cache, though cache-control takes precedence
